desc:
Mine diamonds, sell them and get rich! 
(💰 Earn money while offline)

⛏️ Mine blocks and dig deeper
💎 Sell your diamonds for cash
🏠 Upgrade your base
📦 Find chests in hidden caves
⚠️ Watch out for obstacles that make you lose diamonds
🔨 Craft new pickaxes
🚀 Unlock 18 pickaxes and 5 drills
🔄 Rebirth and go again
🏆 Get on the leaderboards

Play on 📱 Mobile, 🎮 Console and 💻 PC
